arms.additive: AdditiveCodePredictor: c = W_delta phi(Delta) + b + W_alpha e_alpha (Linear 16 -> 128 with bias, Embedding 3 x 128, Linear 128 -> 128 no bias); FiLM blocks unchanged

controls.wrong_anchor: each arm's J from the 480 fit-split anchors over the 16 grid candidates

arms.factored: FactoredFiLMPredictor: per block G_d: Linear(16, 768) on phi(Delta), G_a: Linear(128, 768) on e_alpha (Embedding 3 x 128), both zero-initialised; norm(h)(1 + g_d)(1 + g_a) + b_d + b_a; no code MLP
arms.fused: the Gate-B LC hybrid handoff checkpoints (CNNHybridPredictor); J = the #101 J (pe, 1e-4)
arms.initialisation: torch.manual_seed(seed); the CNNHybridPredictor constructor first, then the request path is replaced: trunk, heads and adapters start equal to the fused member of the same seed (smoke-checked)

rankers.J: #101 pe DP lambda 1e-4 policy trained for each new arm on the #109 policy pool (2 DAgger rounds, distillation)

projection.note: training projected at the full-cost (horizon 225 + ranking) update time: an upper bound

caps.scope_rule: if the projected elapsed time on 4 GPUs exceeds 48.0 h, finish blocked with the projection; never cut scope

claim_boundary: one look at the sealed #109 evaluation split; grid ranking primary, other inventories DESCRIPTIVE; rollout error stands regardless of Gate B; tie-free cost; DESCRIPTIVE intervals; NovPhy E99 carriers, the LC hybrid at the Gate-B budget only

decision_rule.contrast_tokens: delta rule, DESCRIPTIVE: supported iff mean >= 0.02 with lower bound > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff upper < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.coupling: per block, the effective FiLM scale gamma and shift beta at the nine requests (factored: gamma = (1 + g_d)(1 + g_a) - 1, beta = b_d + b_a), two-way decomposition over (Delta, alpha): interaction share SS_int / SS_total, the interaction share of the alpha (Delta) variation, the variance over alpha at fixed Delta (and vice versa) relative to the mean squared norm (identity FiLM = 0), rms; float64 on CPU; seed means; fused = the Gate-B checkpoints; no training
decision_rule.disposition_1_rollout: 'an additive request code matches the fused code within 1.5x per-request rollout error at t = 225' (aligned with #117): per fixed request r, the geometric ratio additive / fused of the #100 engine_position_mse at t = 225 on the mixed grid candidates (per level: candidate mean per (level, seed), mean over the seeds usable in both arms, log ratio; bootstrap over levels). Per request: 'supported' iff the upper bound < 1.5; 'not_supported_by_this_experiment' iff the lower bound > 1.5; otherwise (or < 3 levels) readiness_or_precision_insufficient. Overall: supported iff all nine requests are supported; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff any request is; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.disposition_2_ranking: 'axis interaction in the request code carries measurable decision value': grid, paired by (level, seed), level-clustered, D = AUC(fused) - AUC(additive) of the nine-fixed-request mean (each request 1/9). delta rule: supported iff mean >= 0.02 and lower bound > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff upper bound < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient. The J contrast (each arm's own J) is reported beside it with its own token and does not enter the disposition
decision_rule.guards: a failed guard turns every token (both dispositions and every table) into readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.macs: cnn_hybrid.linear_macs (#103 / #114 accounting: executed linear operators per predictor call; code and FiLM generators counted per row) per call per request, and per candidate-state (one candidate rollout to t = 225, policy calls included), pooled over grid blocks and seeds
decision_rule.ratio_tokens: the disposition-1 per-request rule at every endpoint and for factored / fused (DESCRIPTIVE)
decision_rule.rollout_error: #100 engine_position_mse of every mixed grid candidate at t in [15, 30, 60, 150, 225] (fixed requests: the same rollout stopped at t; J at 225 only) against its own branch at min(t, last frame); candidate mean per (level, seed), seed mean per level, level bootstrap

disclosure: Known before the freeze: Gate B (unit 0.7444, prior 0.7203 on grid), #101 (J grid 0.706), #114, #105, #115 (Gate-B rollout error t = 225 F-1/5/15-micro 0.030 / 0.038 / 0.042), #116 (the 9000-update recipe looks undertrained on the fit split), #117 (1.5x rule; joint vs specialists). No additive or factored model existed; no coupling statistic of the Gate-B checkpoints was computed before the freeze. Hardware: RTX 5090 instead of the #85 RTX 3090. Pre-freeze: the analysis and rendering code was exercised on synthetic random rows over fit-split cells posing as the evaluation set (no model output, no evaluation capture; random-init models for the coupling code); a first smoke passed on a revision that differed in the findings layout, the guard-failure propagation into the per-request disposition tokens and this disclosure; a second passed on a revision that differed only in this disclosure; the smoke was rerun on the frozen runner (logs/smoke-first-revision.log, logs/smoke-second-revision.log, logs/smoke.log).

evaluation.cell_auc: m99.view; cells (level, seed); bootstrap over levels (10000 draws, PCG64 7201)
evaluation.engine_truth: built after the freeze: s99.shot_labels of every mixed grid branch at positions min(t, last), t in [15, 30, 60, 150, 225]
evaluation.rollout: rp.rollout_endpoints (the #101 path; fixed requests stopped at each t on grid)
evaluation.split: the #109 evaluation split as in Gate B (stream issue109-evaluation, mixed cells)

guards.G5_replication: the smoke training-path replication passed, and the fused rows (and J schedules and linear MACs) equal the #101 records on every inventory, cell and seed

changing an arm, rule or recipe after the freeze
retrying or replacing a typed failure
question: does the fused MLP request code re-couple horizon and description, and does the coupling carry rollout accuracy or decision value that an additive code lacks?
request_path_verified: CNNHybridPredictor.carrier: code = PairConditioner.code(pair) = MLP[phi(Delta) (16 sinusoids); e_alpha (128)] (144 -> 256 SiLU -> 128), broadcast over the batch; in each of the 3 FiLMBlocks a zero-initialised Linear(128, 768) gives scale gamma / shift beta: norm(h)(1 + gamma) + beta. alpha also selects the input adapter (micro / macro symbolic features of the current carrier added to the input projection); that path depends on alpha only and is identical in every arm
role: request-code ablation of the LC hybrid: fused (control) vs additive vs factored-FiLM; confirmatory on the sealed #109 evaluation split (Gate B passed); rollout error stands regardless

projection.note: training projected at the full-cost (horizon 225 + ranking) update time: an upper bound

smoke_evidence.reading: fit-split payload, cells, anchors and branches; the Gate-B checkpoints and #101 policies; no evaluation-split capture or model output

training.data: the v3 retrain payload (#109 fit split), hash-checked
training.policy: #101 pe recipe: rp.new_policy(seed), 2 DAgger rounds of rp.window_rows (lambda 1e-4) on the #101 pool, rp.distil_round, under deterministic_scoring
training.recipe: #112 v3 LC exactly as the Gate-B retrain (rt.implementation; only s99.new_predictor returns the arm's class): #77 local loss + long-horizon supervision to 225 + decision-contrastive ranking loss, truncation 45, skip-on-nonfinite, AdamW lr 1e-4 wd 1e-4, clip 1, batch 64, 9000 updates (the matched budget), PAIRS[step % 9], fold 'all', one member per group
training.replication_guard: smoke: the training path configured as fused equals rt.implementation().train_group bit for bit after 12 full-cost updates (parameters, every local loss)
training.typed_failures: an unusable member is a typed terminal failure: not retrained, no policy, its cells drop
training.usable: complete, at most 45 skipped updates, no #117 end-of-training excursion (rt.excursion)
